text:
Maya: Quick midweek poll — what's the objectively best pizza topping? roommate says pineapple is a crime, pls help settle this. :thinking_face:
Devin: Pepperoni. Forever. :pizza:
Alex K.: Anchovies for the brave. Also pineapple is a mood. :evergreen_tree::pineapple:
Li Wei: Pineapple gets way too much hate. It balances sweet+salty, fight me. :pineapple:
Sophia: Mushrooms + garlic butter crust. Quietly superior. :mushroom:
Jordan: If it's not cheese-only I'm skeptical. Basil + olive oil > everything. :herb:
Maya: Alright — pepperoni, margherita/cheese, pineapple, mushrooms, anchovies, other. React with emoji and we'll tally. @here
lunch-bot: Poll created — react with 🍕 for pepperoni, 🧀 for margherita/cheese, 🍍 for pineapple, 🍄 for mushrooms, 🐟 for anchovies, ✅ for other
Devin: Also adding: jalapeños are an underrated chaos agent. :hot_pepper:
Alex K.: Someone should invent a split crust with both anchovies and pineapple, call it the "compromise" :grimacing:
Li Wei: I will personally buy coffee for the team if pineapple wins today. :coffee: :pineapple:
Sophia: Quick tally in thread so far: 🍕 x2, 🍍 x1, 🍄 x1 — not scientific but vibes. :bar_chart:
Jordan: If pepperoni wins I'm bringing leftover slices to the kitchen. Winner gets a cookie. :cookie:
Maya: Closing poll at 15:00 PT. thanks for the chaos, will report back with final emoji counts. :tada:
